en.org: Vitality Design develops new experiences and businesses in hospitality and tourism by connecting places, people, culture and technology. We are currently developing our business through conversations with accommodation and tourism operators.
en.person: Shota Yamamoto does not come from the accommodation industry. He has travelled to more than 25 countries, experiencing cities, cultures, places to stay, architecture, food and the people he met. Professionally he has worked in corporate sales, new business development, equipment deployment, construction projects, partner development, process design and cost management, carrying concepts through to actually running on site.
en.page: Connecting the value scattered across a region to create the experience that only that place can give rise to.
en.svc: DISCOVER the value that exists because of that place. CONNECT people, culture, space, region and technology that were separate. CREATE a new experience that exists only there. EVOLVE it from how people actually respond. Possibilities include a stay connecting a hotel to local culture, an immersive experience combining historic architecture and technology, a cultural experience connecting travellers to sake breweries and workshops, an experience integrating food, sound, light, projection and space, and an experience staged across a whole town. These are examples of what we can handle, not a service menu, and there are no proven results at this stage.
en.pname: Creating experiences that exist only there. | Vitality Design LLC
en.slogan: Creating experiences that exist only there.
en.svcname: Creating experiences that exist only there
en.svctype: Planning, development and implementation of experiences connecting places, people, culture and technology

zh.org: Vitality Design 致力于住宿与旅游领域，连接场所、人、文化与技术，创造新的体验与事业。目前正通过与住宿设施和旅游相关经营者的对话，推进事业的具体化。
zh.person: 山本翔太并非出身住宿行业。他曾走访 25 个以上国家，体验过各地的城市、文化、住宿、建筑、饮食与人的相遇。在工作上，曾从事企业销售、新事业、设备导入、施工项目、合作伙伴开拓、业务设计与成本管理，并一直负责到让构想在现场真正运转为止。
zh.page: 连接散落于地域中的价值，创造只有那个场所才能孕育的体验。
zh.svc: DISCOVER 发现只有那个场所才存在的价值。CONNECT 连接原本分离的人、文化、空间、地域与技术。CREATE 创造只有在那个场所才能实现的新体验。EVOLVE 依据真实的反应培育体验。可能的形态包括连接酒店与地域文化的住宿体验、结合历史建筑与技术的沉浸式体验、连接酒窖与工坊与旅行者的文化体验、整合饮食与声音与光与影像与空间的体验，以及以整个街区为舞台的体验。这些是我们能够处理的可能性示例，并非服务清单，现阶段也没有已验证的成果。
zh.pname: 创造只有在那里才能实现的体验。｜Vitality Design 合同会社
zh.slogan: 创造只有在那里才能实现的体验。
